sentences.text: Sarcolestes is a dinosaur belonging to the class Ornithischia and the parent group Ankylosauria.
It is one of the few known ankylosaurians from the Middle Jurassic period, reaching a length of approximately 3 meters.
The only known specimen consists of a partial left mandible and a fused scute damaged during excavation.
The preserved jaw contains one entire tooth and two crown tips, with the central section of the bone missing.
Richard Lydekker named the genus and species Sarcolestes in 1893, initially believing it was a theropod.
Franz Nopcsa classified Sarcolestes as a herbivorous stegosaurid in 1901.
Peter Galton later concluded that Sarcolestes belongs to the nodosaurid family based on its dentary similarity to Sauropelta.
Sarcolestes lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 162 million years ago in the Callovian stage in what is now Europe, with a time range estimated between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago.
Some researchers have questioned the classification of Sarcolestes within Nodosauridae and even its validity as a distinct genus.
